s: Zeman bediqat hechametz ubo y"a seipim: ap al pi sheen adam ober al chametzo be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" ella millel t"v benisan vaelak, kemo shekkatub "shibat yamim seor lo yimmatze bebattekem vego' velo yeraeh leka seor bekol gebulka shibat yamim vego'", abal qodem shibat yamim eno ober belo taaseh kesheshshaha hechametz bebeto, mikkol maqom ober al mitzvat aseh mechatzot yom y"d vaelak bekol rega verega sheeno mebaer hechametz min haolam, shenneemar "shibat yamim matztzot tokelu, ak bayyom harishon tashbitu seor mibbattekem vego'", umippi hashshemua lamedu sheyyom rishon zeh hu y"d benisan, veniqra rishon leshibat yeme happesach, kelomar qodem lahem, vekavvanat hakkatub lomar: "shibat yamim matztzot tokelu", ubayyom sheqqodem "shibat yamim" — "tashbitu seor vego'". Reaya ledabar zeh mimmah sheomra tora: "lo tishchat al chametz dam zibchi", kelomar "lo tishchat" et happesach vaadayin chametz qayyam, uzeman shechitat happesach hu bey"d mechatzot hayyom ulemala, mikkan atta lamed shezzeman hashbatat hechametz hu bizman shechitat happesach, dehaynu mechatzot yom y"d ulemala:

Umah hi hashbata zo sheomra tora? Hu sheyyashbit vibaer hechametz min haolam legamre ad sheshshum adam lo yukal od lehanot mimmennu, veal derek sheyyitbaer besiman tm"h. Abal im rotzeh lebattelo ulehapqiro — en zeh moil kelum. Bammeh debarim amurim? Leachar shehiggia zeman issur akilato vahanaato min hattora, dehaynu mechatzot hayyom y"d ulemala, shehaokel o hanneheneh az min hechametz ober belo taaseh, shenneemar "lo tokal alayv chametz", kelomar al qorban happesach. Velo ba hakkatub lehazhir shello leekol chametz bishat akilat happesach, dehaynu belel t"v, shehare kebar neemar "velo yeakel chametz", ella ba lehazhir shello leekol chametz bishat shechitat happesach, dehaynu mechatzot yom y"d ulemala. Veqibbelu chakamim sheissur chametz bey"d domeh leissuro kol z' yeme happesach, shekkeshem shekkol z' yeme happesach hu asur apillu bahanaa min hattora, shenneemar "velo yeakel", kelomar lo yehe bo hetter hammebi lide shum akila, apillu shel hetter, dehaynu hetter hanaa, shessetam hanaa baa lide akila, shelloqeach bedamim maakal — kak mechatzot yom y"d ulemala hu asur apillu bahanaa, vekevan sheasur lo lehanot mimmennu hare en lo shum zekut bo veeno shello kelal, ulepikak eno yakol lebattelo ulehapqiro. Abal qodem shehiggia zeman issur hanaato, yakol hu lebattelo ulehapqiro, umuttar lo min hattora lehashhoto immo babbayit kol yeme happesach, sheeno ober min hattora be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" ella al chametz shello shello hipqiro, shenneemar "velo yeraeh leka", shelleka, i atta roeh, abal atta roeh shel acherim veshel hepqer:

Abal chakamim gazeru sheen bittul vehepqer moil kelum lechametz ap qodem shehiggia zeman issur hanaato, ella hu tzarik lechappes acharayv bammachaboot ubachorim (im derek lehishtammesh sham kol hashshana kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tl"g) velibdoq ulehotzio mikkol gebulo velaasot lo kammishpat sheyyitbaer besiman tm"h:

Umippene b' debarim nizqequ chakamim lekak. Ha', lepi shehabbittul vehahepqer taluy bemachashabto shel adam, sheyyapqirennu beleb shalem veyotziennu millibbo legamre, ulepi sheen daat kol bene adam shavin, veepshar mi sheyyaqel baddabar velo yapqirennu beleb shalem velo yotziennu millibbo legamre, lepikak gazeru sheen bittul vehepqer moil kelum ad sheyyotzi et hechametz mikkol gebulo (ayyen siman tm"h). Hab' lepi shehaadam ragil bekol hashshana bechametz, umechamat regiluto qarob hu leshikcha, sheyyishkach et issuro veyokal mimmennu im yihyeh munnach bigbulo bepesach, lepikak hitzriku lechappes acharayv velibdoq ulehotzio mikkol gebulo qodem sheyyaggia zeman issur akilato:

Uzeman bediqa zo min haddin haya rauy leqobah beyom y"d bitchillat shaa shishshit, kede sheyyashlim kol echad bediqato besop shaa shishshit, vibaer hechametz bitchillat shaa shebiit kammishpat haamur battora, ukemo sheyyitbaer besiman tm"h. Ella lepi shebbayyom rob bene adam enam metzuyim bebattehem, ella terudin beisqehem bashshevaqim ubarechobot, ukeshettaggia shaa shishshit qarob haddabar sheyyishkechu chobat habbediqa, lepikak tiqqenu chakamim zeman habbediqa belel y"d, shebballayla kol adam matzuy betok beto. Ella sheap beodo betok beto yesh lachosh shemma yitasseq baakila ushetiyya veshena o bimlaka, o betora im hu talmid chakam, veal yede ken yishkach chobat habbediqa, lepikak haya rauy letaqqen veliqboa zeman habbediqa tekep umiyyad biknisat haadam letok beto samuk laereb, shebberega zo hu panuy mikkol asaqim. Ella lepi shetztzarik lechappes acharayv bachorim ubassedaqim, vechippus zeh i epshar ella leor hanner, shenneemar "baet hahi achappes et yerushalam bannerot vego'", mikkan sameku chakamim sheor hanner yapeh libdiqat chametz, veen hanner meir umabhiq yapeh bayyom ki im ballayla, lepikak echaru zeman habbediqa ad zeman habhaqat hanner, dehaynu tzet hakkokabim [kesheyyesh adayin or hayyom qetzat]. Ubeoto zeman shebben kenisat haadam lebeto uben zeman habbediqa, dehaynu tzet hakkokabim, veshiur oto zeman shebbenehem kemo chatzi shaa, aseru lo leekol velilmod apillu pereq echad, ap al pi sheyyukal ligmor happereq qodem tzet hakkokabim, mikkol maqom yesh lachosh shemma al yede iyyuno belimmudo yishkach chobat habbediqa veyilmod yoter, o shemma yabo lo iyyun chadash belimmudo veyishheh beiyyuno ad zeman ma leachar tzet hakkokabim (kesheyyesh adayin or hayyom qetzat). Veken aseru bachatzi shaa zo laasot kol haddebarim haasurim laasotam qodem tepillat mincha o tepillat arbit, kemo shennitbaer siman rl"b vrl"h. Umi sheshshakach velo badaq belel arbaa asar venizkar beyom arbaa asar, hare hu asur bekol haddebarim hallalu ad sheyyibdoq:

Vaapillu im haya oseq beechad mikkol haddebarim hallalu qodem shehiggia zeman habbediqa, chayyab lehapsiq kesheyyaggia zemannah, apillu haya oseq behetter, dehaynu shehitchil laasoq qodem chatzi shaa lipne tzet hakkokabim, vaapillu hu oseq betalmud tora, sheim lo yapsiq libdoq miyyad bitchillat kenisat hallayla ap al pi sheyyibdoq achar kak — hare zeh mebattel taqqanat chakamim, shettiqqenu libdoq betzet hakkokabim miyyad, kesheyyesh adayin or hayyom qetzat. Veap al pi sheadayin lo qara qeriat shema shel arbit, uqeriat shema hi mitzvat aseh shel tora, vegam hi tedira, bekol yom veyom b' peamim qeriat shema, vekol hattadir mechabero qodem et chabero, ap al pi ken tzarik lehaqdim et habbediqa lipne qeriat shema utepilla, lepi shehi mitzva oberet, sheim lo yibdoq miyyad betzet hakkokabim — hare hu niqra ober al taqqanat chakamim. Abal biqriat shema, ap al pi shemmitzva min hammubchar liqrotah bitchillat hallayla, mikkol maqom eno niqra ober al taqqanat chakamim ella im ken qore otah achar chatzi hallayla, kemo shennitbaer besiman rl"h:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemi sheragil lehitpallel qeriat shema utepilla shel arbit kol hashshana betok beto. Abal mi sheragil lehitpallel kol hashshana im hatztzibbur mibbeod yom veakshav lo hitpallel immahem — yiqra qeriat shema veyitpallel miyyad betzet hakkokabim veachar kak yibdoq, dekevan sheeno ragil kol hashshana lehitpallel arbit bebeto, yesh lachosh shemma al yede tirdato vehishtaddeluto bibdiqat hechametz yishkach al qeriat shema utepilla:

Vekol zeh bitpillat yachid, abal im yesh asara shemmitpallelim arbit bizmanno, dehaynu tzet hakkokabim, yitpallelu miyyad betzet hakkokabim veachar kak yeleku lebattehem libdoq hechametz, sheim yeleku libdoq qodem tepillat arbit yihyeh torach leqabbetzam achar kak lehitpallel baasara, vetitbattel mitzvat tepillat hatztzibbur legamre mechamat haqdamat habbediqa, abal im yitpallelu baasara qodem habbediqa — lo titbattel mitzvat habbediqa legamre:

Veken bimqomot sheyyesh chaburot sheyyesh lahem shiur qabua lilmod halakot pesuqot bebet hakkeneset achar hattepilla, al yebattelu limmudam belayla zo mechamat bediqat chametz, shehare epshar libdoq achar kak velo titbattel mitzvat habbediqa legamre. Veen lachosh shemma yimmasheku belimmudam ad sheyyishkechu chobat habbediqa, shehare mukrachim hem labo el battehem lalun, shebbevadday lo yalinu bebet hakkeneset, ukesheyyabo kol echad mehem lebeto yizkor chobat habbediqa:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheoseqin bidbar halaka belo pilpul, abal asur laasoq bepilpul apillu bebet hakkeneset, sheyyesh lachosh shemma yimshok kol kak bepilpul ad sheyyihyeh libbo tarud beoto pilpul veyishkach chobat habbediqa ap beboo lebeto:

Im hu yosheb velomed qodem tzet hakkokabim veomer lachabero sheeno lomed shekkesheyyaggia zeman habbediqa yazkir oto veyapsiqo millimmudo — hare zeh muttar, ap im hu tok chatzi shaa lipne tzet hakkokabim.
